basic_details.post_name: Executive Trainee (Mechanical), Executive Trainee (Electrical), Executive Trainee (Civil) and 2 more
basic_details.short_information: Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC), Kolkata, West Bengal, has invited applications for 108 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. PLR/ET/04/2026/05. The posts include Executive Trainee (Mechanical), Executive Trainee (Electrical), Executive Trainee (Civil), Executive Trainee (C&I) and 1 more. The online application is open from 6 November 2026 to 6 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will DVC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Marks obtained (out of 100) in the corresponding GATE-2025 paper Shortlisting for Document Verification (DV) in order of merit, 1:5 or more to category-wise vacancies in each discipline Document Verification Pre-Employment Medical Examination by DVC Medical Board before joining Candidates are shortlisted for DV at 1:5 or more of category-wise vacancies in each discipline; DVC may increase or decrease the ratio DV date, time and venue are hosted on the DVC website only; no hard-copy call letters are sent Equal marks in the final merit list are ranked by date of birth, older candidate first

content_sections.heading: DVC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Qualifying marks in GATE-2025 are decided by the GATE-2025 conducting authority

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printout of online application form Original GATE 2025 scorecard and GATE-2025 admit card Proof of date of birth (Class Xth board or passing certificate) Certificates and mark sheets of Class Xth, XIIth and degree, semester-wise/year-wise Valid degree or provisional degree certificate Category, EWS or PwBD certificate, NOC from current employer, four passport size photographs and identity proof, as applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DVC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: From 06/11/2026, register online at www.dvc.gov.in under Career Section, Recruitment Notices. Apply online only; no other mode of application is accepted. Apply for one post/discipline only. Indicate the percentage of marks equivalent to CGPA/OGPA/DGPA or letter grade in the application form. General/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates pay Rs 300/- online by 06/12/2026 and download the e-receipt. Submit the online application by 06/12/2026 (till 23:59 hrs).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Vacancies are projected and may increase or decrease at the discretion of DVC Management Candidates employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate at DV Updates and amendments will be published on the DVC website only

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 6 December 2026. Applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 108 vacancies: 17 Executive Trainee (Mechanical), 50 Executive Trainee (Electrical), 26 Executive Trainee (Civil), 12 Executive Trainee (C&I), 3 Executive Trainee (Mining).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DVC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/OBC(NCL)/EWS: Rs 300 (non-refundable). SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM and DVC Departmental candidates: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 29 years (as on closing date of online application). Relaxation: OBC (NCL) 3 years, SC/ST 5 years, PwBD (General/UR) 10 years, PwBD with OBC (NCL) 13 years, PwBD with SC/ST 15 years, J&K domicile 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989 5 years, Ex-Servicemen / Victims of riots As per Govt. of India guidelines, DVC Departmental candidates No upper age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs 56,100-1,77,500 in Pay Matrix Level-10 of 7th CPC (M2 grade) for Executive Trainee (Mechanical), Rs 56,100-1,77,500 in Pay Matrix Level-10 of 7th CPC (M2 grade) for Executive Trainee (Electrical), Rs 56,100-1,77,500 in Pay Matrix Level-10 of 7th CPC (M2 grade) for Executive Trainee (Civil), Rs 56,100-1,77,500 in Pay Matrix Level-10 of 7th CPC (M2 grade) for Executive Trainee (C&I), Rs 56,100-1,77,500 in Pay Matrix Level-10 of 7th CPC (M2 grade) for Executive Trainee (Mining).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology in the post's discipline from an AICTE / appropriate statutory authority approved University/Institution, with 65% marks (Gen/OBC(NCL)/EWS) or 60% marks (SC/ST/PwD) in aggregate; valid GATE-2025 score in the corresponding paper. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian nationals can apply. A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose degree is not approved by AICTE/appropriate statutory authority. Candidates without valid GATE-2025 marks in the corresponding paper.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Marks obtained (out of 100) in the corresponding GATE-2025 paper. Shortlisting for Document Verification (DV) in order of merit, 1:5 or more to category-wise vacancies in each discipline. Document Verification. Pre-Employment Medical Examination by DVC Medical Board before joining.
